name: Theatrix Hawaii - Audio Visual Company - Maui
old_description: Theatrix Hawaii specializes in event production throughout Hawaii. We have warehouses on Oahu and Maui, but also operate on Kaua'i, the Big Island and Lana'i. We can help make the event you envision a reality.
about:
Theatrix Hawaii was founded in 2001 by Jack Hufstetler in Kahului, Hawaii. The company began as an audio-visual and event production firm serving the Hawaiian Islands, growing from a local operation into a multi-island service provider.

The company provides a full range of event production services including lighting, audio, video, staging, rigging, décor, special effects, CAD design, fabrication, and heavy equipment services. It operates warehouses on Oahu and Maui and extends services to Kauai, the Big Island, and Lanai, handling events from intimate gatherings to arena-sized productions.

Theatrix serves corporate event planners, concert promoters, government and military organizations, non-profits, and healthcare institutions. Past clients include the USO for Toby Keith concerts, the USS Missouri Memorial Association, AFCEA International's TechNet Asia Pacific conference, Multi Image Group, and Hawaii Pacific Health.

The company distinguishes itself as the only firm in Hawaii holding a rigging and electrical contractor's license (C-29606). It emphasizes an experienced technician team, attention to detail, and over two decades of island-wide event experience.
